decisions: Use the production Rust binder, with only its base-map trait supplied by exact decoded committed B3 tile payloads. Non-production provisional entries and their descendants are omitted according to compiler source; all 780 retained entries use the palette appearance key forms accepted by WorldBase. Native merged item profiles are loaded through NativeGameplayInput::from_manifest; admission reproduces inventory/materializable/container predicates from production caller.
The map adapter proves committed-source UID/appearance bindings. It does not claim deployed bundle identity or actual public-spawn access.
Do not promote a source-fixture reward USE test to whole-quest playability or mark unbound claims live just because readiness is ready.
